Hello, my name is Jaehyuk, but everyone calls me Jay. I am currently a second-year PhD student in the [Department of Statistics](https://statistics.rutgers.edu/) at [Rutgers University](https://www.rutgers.edu/). I am fortunate to be advised by Professor [Matteo Bonvini](https://www.matteobonvini.com/) and Professor [Pierre Bellec](https://bellecp.github.io/).

My research interests fall into two strands: **nonparametric causal inference** and **uncertainty quantification for iterative algorithms**.

Before coming to Rutgers, I finished my Master's at Seoul National University, where I had the privilege of working under Professor Kwonsang Lee.
